motive.zhHans: 一直跟踪光彦的犯人开口并出现在光彦身后：“原来藏在那儿啊”。犯人也相当好奇，因为他同样没有找到珠宝的藏匿地点，于是问光彦是怎么知道的。显然，Izumiya递给Kimishima的不是装满食物的手提包，而是装满钱的手提包。柯南还告诉光彦不要着急，因为他已经报警了，Izumiya大概很快就会被逮捕。
motive.en: The culprit who was stalking Mitsuhiko spoke and shwoed up behind Mitsuhiko: "So that's where it was hidden". The culprit also got fairly curious, because he also did not find the location of the jewels, so he asked Mitsuhiko how he knew it. Obviously, the purse Izumiya handed to Kimishima was not a purse filled with food but instead a purse filled with money. Conan also told Mitsuhiko not to be anxious since he had already informed the police about it and Izumiya would probably be arrested soon.

method.zhHans: 在这个案子里，大概是为了换取Kimishima用鸽子偷来的珠宝。他很担心犯人会检查袋子里的东西，所以用鸽子把他吓跑。而事实上，Izumiya被几名警察按倒在地，当他意识到自己从光彦那里拿到的只是弹珠时，他惊呼自己被“那个小鬼”骗了。
method.en: In this case, it was probably to trade for the jewels Kimishima stole using the pigeons. He was quite worried that the culprit would verify the content in the bag, so he used the pigeon to scare him away. And in fact, Izumiya was being held down by several police on the ground, and when he realised the bag he got from Mitsuhiko was just some marbles, he exclaimed that he got tricked by "that brat".

evidence.zhHans: 他拉开了鸟屋底部的小抽屉，发现了一个袋子里装着一个盒子。另外，之前那名公园游客穿的是皮靴，和小屋外的脚印一样，这意味着他是唯一的嫌疑人。而且根据犯罪现场，他没有发现任何迹象表明犯人找到了珠宝。怒火中烧的Izumiya从失物招领箱里（原本有两根）拿起其中一根球棒，敲击Kimishima的头部。
evidence.en: He pulled out the little drawer at the bottom of the birdhouse, and he found a bag that contained a box. Also, the park visitor from before was wearing leather boots, just like the footprints outside the shed, meaning that he is the only possible culprit. And according to the crime scene, he did not find any traits that show the culprit found the jewels. Along with his anger, Izumiya took one of the bats placed in the lost-and-found box (there were two initially) and struck Kimishima's head.

resolution.zhHans: 沿着自己的推理，光彦来到公园小屋，走向鸟屋。“果然没错。”光彦说道。他拉开了鸟屋底部的小抽屉，发现了一个袋子里装着一个盒子。他打开它，里面显然是Kimishima偷来的珠宝。一直跟踪光彦的犯人开口并出现在光彦身后：“原来藏在那儿啊”。当光彦回头时，他意识到犯人就是Hayato Izumiya，也就是今天早上“用手提包喂鸟食”的那个人。另外，之前那名公园游客穿的是皮靴，和小屋外的脚印一样，这意味着他是唯一的嫌疑人。
resolution.en: Persuing his own deduction, Mitsuhiko went to the park shed, and he headed towards the birdhouse. "Just as I thought," Mitsuhiko uttered. He pulled out the little drawer at the bottom of the birdhouse, and he found a bag that contained a box. When he opened it, it was clearly the jewellery Kimishima stole. The culprit who was stalking Mitsuhiko spoke and shwoed up behind Mitsuhiko: "So that's where it was hidden". When Mitsuhiko turned his head backwards, he realised that the culprit was Hayato Izumiya, the person who was "giving bird food in a purse" this morning. Also, the park visitor from before was wearing leather boots, just like the footprints outside the shed, meaning that he is the only possible culprit.

summary.en: After a long day of helping to clean and tidy the birdhouses at the park shed, the Detective Boys inquired of the park warden, Satoshi Kimishima, if he had more work to deploy to them. Fearing that he would not trust their abilities, they introduced themselves. After that, Kimishima finally asked them if they could find the owner of a hat that had stayed in the lost-and-found box for so long that it was time to dispose of it. After the Detective Boys had accepted the offer, the park warden walked towards another man, Hayato Izumiya, who was handing Kimishima a big purse filled with stuff. According to the park warden, there are many visitors that give the birds food, so it must be a bag full of food.
